title: The constructor offers a template's new fields to a copy made before them, and adds them only when asked
description: A location type whose stored copy has only the template's first 8 fields (a copy made on 17-10-2026, before the template grew: /estrategia-web-ct-test/v1/template-copy): its edit screen (assets/constructor.js) offers the missing ones with their count; adding them puts them in the draft (the notice goes away) and stores nothing; saving stores the template's fields in the template's order and nothing is missing any more. Read by browser-ct-template-fields. It was the second test of hours-editor.test.mjs (level 3) until 29-10-2026.

values.after: wp.apiFetch({ path: '/estrategia-web/v1/content-types/eweb_location' }).then((r) => ({ fields: r.definition.fields.map((f) => f.name), missing: r.missingFields }))
